items.title: PB Experience Party Pass — 5+ Clubs
items.description: Weekly Friday night party pass covering 5+ clubs in Pacific Beach, produced by Levinson Group and San Diego Crawls. Starts at Riptides at 9pm; wristband gets you into participating venues through the night. A commercial crawl product that runs rain or shine — check their Eventbrite for the current price and club lineup.

items.title: PB Party Pass — Party With Us
items.description: Friday night Pacific Beach party pass from Certified Baddie Entertainment, starting at Riptides PB at 9pm. Same starting venue and time as the Levinson Group crawl, but a different commercial product with a different club lineup. Check their Eventbrite for the current venue list and ticket price.

items.title: San Diego Bachelorette & Bachelor Bar Crawl
items.description: Weekly Thursday bar crawl from SD Crawls specifically designed for bachelorette and bachelor parties, starting at Tavern at the Beach at 4pm. Groups get wristband access to multiple PB venues. Custom packages available for larger parties — check their Eventbrite for the current pricing tiers.

items.title: Pacific Beach Oktoberfest Bar Crawl
items.description: PubCrawls.com's annual Pacific Beach Oktoberfest crawl, starting at 710 Beach Club at 4pm. German-themed drinking specials across multiple PB venues. One-day event — ticket includes wristband access and first drink at the starting venue. Check their Eventbrite for the current price and which bars are participating.

items.title: PB Halloween Bar Crawl — Oct 24 (PubCrawls.com)
items.description: PubCrawls.com's pre-Halloween Pacific Beach bar crawl on Saturday Oct 24. Starts at 710 Beach Club at 4pm. Halloween costumes strongly encouraged — most bars will have themed specials. Ticket includes wristband access to all participating venues. First of two PubCrawls.com Halloween events in PB; the main one is Oct 31.

items.title: Trick or Drink — PB Halloween Crawl
items.description: Barcrawlerz produces Trick or Drink, a separate Halloween bar crawl running the same day as PubCrawls.com's event but starting from Flamingo Deck at 4pm. Different organizer, different club lineup. Costume required. Check their Eventbrite for the current venue list and whether it runs indoors or partly on the boardwalk.

items.title: PB Zombie Crawl — Friday Night
items.description: Nasstive Entertainment's Pacific Beach Zombie Crawl, night one: Friday Oct 30. One wristband grants access to 10+ participating PB bars. Zombie makeup and costume is part of the deal — face painters are usually at the starting point early in the evening. Runs 7pm through the end of bar hours. The Saturday night is the bigger turnout.

items.title: PB Zombie Crawl — Halloween Night
items.description: Night two of the Nasstive Entertainment Pacific Beach Zombie Crawl — Halloween itself. Wristband access to 10+ PB bars; costume is expected. The actual Halloween date draws the biggest crowd of the two-night run. Same wristband program as Friday; check their Eventbrite if you only want one night.

items.title: PB Halloween Bar Fest — Mad City
items.description: Mad City Bar Fest's Pacific Beach Halloween Bar Fest, starting at noon on Halloween. An earlier-in-the-day format compared to the evening crawls — opens up Halloween to a longer day of bar hopping. Multi-venue wristband. Check their Eventbrite for the current starting venue; the listing had no specific address.

items.title: PB Official Halloween Bar Crawl (PubCrawls.com)
items.description: PubCrawls.com's main Pacific Beach Halloween Bar Crawl on Halloween night. Starts at Pueblo at 3pm. Costume required for entry. Wristband access to all participating venues. This is the same company that runs the Oct 24 pre-Halloween crawl — the Oct 31 version is their primary event.

items.title: PB Thanksgiving Eve Bar Crawl
items.description: Pacific Beach bar crawl on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving — one of the busiest bar nights of the year. Starts at 5pm; multi-venue wristband format through PB's main bar strip. Check the Eventbrite for the current organizer, starting venue, and price.

items.title: PB SantaCon Bar Crawl
items.description: PubCrawls.com's Pacific Beach SantaCon bar crawl, starting at Pueblo at 4pm on December 12. Come dressed as Santa, an elf, or anything holiday-themed — the sillier the better. Wristband access to multiple PB venues. One of the bigger non-Halloween crawl events of the year in the neighborhood.

items.title: NYE PB Experience Crawl
items.description: Levinson Group's New Year's Eve Pacific Beach experience crawl, starting at Riptides PB at 8pm. Multi-venue wristband through the NYE night. One of the commercial crawl operators who runs PB every weekend scaling up for NYE. Check their Eventbrite well in advance — NYE inventory sells fast.
